dialog.addIntro: One folder is one project. Chat, runs, logs, and memory work only inside this folder.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameAdoptedHelp: This is the name saved in the folder's settings file. Changing it changes that file.
dialog.idHelp: You can't change it after it's created.
dialog.addedInvalid: Added project “{name}” (settings file error — check it in project home)
dialog.repathNoteConfig: This project's configuration, memory, chat, and run records are in the {dir} folder inside the project folder. If the new folder has no {dir} folder, the configuration looks empty and past records don't show. If you moved the folder, check that you moved the {dir} folder too.
dialog.repathNoteConfigUnknown: This project's configuration, memory, chat, and run records are in the project config folder inside the project folder. If the new folder doesn't have it, the configuration looks empty and past records don't show. If you moved the folder, check that you moved the config folder too.
dialog.repathNoteLogs: Claude Code log sessions opened from the previous path may not show in this project if they don't belong to the new path.
dialog.repathNoteAdopt_one: This project will use the project configuration in this folder (“{name}” · {n} item).
dialog.repathNoteAdopt_other: This project will use the project configuration in this folder (“{name}” · {n} items).
dialog.archivedFound: This folder was registered as “{name}” and then unregistered. You can continue with its earlier records.
dialog.existingFound_one: This folder already has a project configuration: “{name}” · {n} item. It will be loaded as it is. Any chat and run records in the folder show too.
dialog.existingFound_other: This folder already has a project configuration: “{name}” · {n} items. It will be loaded as it is. Any chat and run records in the folder show too.
dialog.existingEmpty: This folder has project settings: “{name}”. It has no items yet. It will be loaded as it is.

unregister.title: Unregister “{name}”
unregister.bodyBefore: The files in the project folder
unregister.bodyAfterUnknown: The project configuration and chat and run records inside the folder also stay, and they show again if you register the same folder again (in this app or another). In this app you can view them read-only under Settings › Projects › Unregistered projects.
unregister.bodyAfter: The project configuration and chat and run records inside it ({dir}) also stay, and they show again if you register the same folder again (in this app or another). In this app you can view them read-only under Settings › Projects › Unregistered projects.

problem.missingBodyUnknown: This folder doesn't exist. It may have been moved or renamed, or the drive may not be connected. Chat and run records and the configuration are in the project config folder inside the folder, so you can't see them until the folder is found again, and new chats and runs are blocked. Records aren't deleted.
problem.notDirBody: This path is a file or something other than a folder.
problem.noAccessBody: The account that runs the server doesn't have permission to read this folder. Fix the permission and select [Check again], or change the path.
problem.unsetBody: This project was created in an earlier version and has no folder. Set a folder to use chat and runs.
problem.conflictBody: This folder is the same as or overlaps another project. This happened in an earlier version, and you need to clean up one of them to use both.
problem.manifestTitle: Can't read the project settings file
problem.manifestRecreateBody: The existing settings file isn't deleted; it's moved to a backup folder inside {dir} (you'll see the full path after it's done). A new file with only the name and description is created. Configuration copies, memory, and chat and run records aren't touched. The project layer settings are emptied.
problem.manifestRecreateBodyUnknown: The existing settings file isn't deleted; it's moved to a backup folder inside the project config folder (you'll see the full path after it's done). A new file with only the name and description is created. Configuration copies, memory, and chat and run records aren't touched. The project layer settings are emptied.
problem.manifestRecreated: Recreated the settings file. The previous file is kept at {path}
problem.manifestRecreateNotNeeded: The settings file is already fine. Refreshed
problem.readonlyBodyUnknown: The project config folder inside this folder isn't writable, so you can't copy or change the configuration, and chat and run records can't be saved, so you can't start chat or runs (viewing and logs still work). Fix the folder's write permission, then select [Check again].
problem.recordsNewerTitle: A newer version of the app created this folder's records
problem.recordsNewerBody: You can read the records, but this app can't start new chats or runs. Update the app.
problem.recordsUnknown: Records can't be written right now
problem.gitignoreOutdatedUnknown: The .gitignore is from an earlier version, so record files and the session archive folder may not be excluded from git.
problem.networkFs: This folder looks like a network drive, so the record file's journal mode was changed. If several apps write at once, it may get slow or be unreadable for a moment.
problem.archivedNote: This project is unregistered. Its records are read-only.
problem.missingBody: This folder doesn't exist. It may have been moved or renamed, or the drive may not be connected. Chat and run records and the configuration are inside the folder ({dir}), so you can't see them until the folder is found again, and new chats and runs are blocked. Records aren't deleted.
problem.manifestBody: Couldn't read {dir}/project.yaml{detail}. You can still view records and logs, but new chats and runs and configuration copying are blocked until the settings file is fixed. You can fix the file yourself or recreate it.
problem.manifestBodyUnknown: Couldn't read the project settings file (project.yaml){detail}. You can still view records and logs, but new chats and runs and configuration copying are blocked until the settings file is fixed. You can fix the file yourself or recreate it.
problem.readonlyBody: The {dir} folder inside this folder isn't writable, so you can't copy or change the configuration, and chat and run records can't be saved, so you can't start chat or runs (viewing and logs still work). Fix the folder's write permission, then select [Check again].
problem.gitignoreOutdated: {dir}/.gitignore is from an earlier version, so record files and the session archive folder may not be excluded from git.

recordsReason.folder_missing: Records can't be shown because the folder wasn't found
recordsReason.readonly: This folder isn't writable and its record file can't be read
recordsReason.corrupt: The record file is damaged and can't be opened
recordsReason.migration_failed: Couldn't upgrade the record file for this app version
recordsReason.busy: Another app is writing the record file, so it can't be opened now
recordsReason.link_disabled: This setup doesn't store project records in the folder

home.notFoundBody: The project list is in the sidebar.
home.pathNote: Folder on the server computer · id {id}
home.settingsSoon: You can open the project settings drawer under Settings › Projects.
home.configEmptyBody: Copy from the shared library or create new ones in this project. They're stored inside this folder, so the folder works on its own.
home.configUnreadable: Can't read the configuration because the folder wasn't found
home.configDeleteBody: Only this project's copy is deleted. The shared library isn't affected.
home.configDeleteRefsUnknown: Can't tell where this is used.
home.configDeleteConflict: Someone changed this. The list was reloaded; check it, then delete again
